joints.name: Dovetailed lap
joints.description: A dovetail drops into its socket while the projecting seat supports the overlapping timber.
joints.sequence: Lower the dovetailed member vertically onto the lap seat.
joints.dimensions: 280 × 280 mm section · 1,520 mm assembled length · half-depth seat

joints.name: Mortise & tenon
joints.description: A rectangular tenon and four shoulders locate a rail against a mortised upright.
joints.sequence: Slide the tenon horizontally through the mortise until all four shoulders seat.
joints.dimensions: 280 × 320 mm post · 260 × 280 mm rail · 100 × 160 mm tenon

joints.name: Corner half-lap
joints.description: Two half-depth rebates meet at a corner, preserving the full assembled thickness.
joints.sequence: Lower the upper rail vertically until the two rebates meet.
joints.dimensions: 240 × 240 mm rails · 120 mm rebates · 840 mm lengths

joints.name: Pinned oblique scarf
joints.description: Oblique cheeks, blind T-shaped heads and a separate central pin create a joint that must engage before it can lock.
joints.sequence: Bring the cheeks together · draw the tongues into their pockets · insert the central pin.
joints.dimensions: 320 mm deep × 320 mm wide · 1,200 mm scarf · 80 mm engagement

stages.label: Mate the oblique cheeks
stages.note: The heads enter through the relieved bays. Their retaining lips are not engaged yet.

stages.label: Engage the blind tongues
stages.note: The 80 mm lengthwise draw captures both T heads behind the lips.

stages.label: Insert the locking pin
stages.note: Only after the shoulders seat does the central pin block lengthwise release.

joints.name: Twin-pinned scarf
joints.description: Reversed stepped scarf faces enter from the side. Two independent pins then secure the joined beam.
joints.sequence: Slide sideways into the scarf · insert the first pin · insert the second.
joints.dimensions: 320 × 360 mm section · 1,100 mm stepped scarf · two 50 × 70 mm pins

joints.name: Housed blind dovetail
joints.description: The beam shoulder enters a shallow housing while the upper dovetail seats in a deeper, half-blind pocket. The interlock is concealed from the side.
joints.sequence: Lower the dovetail into its pocket while seating the full-height shoulder.
joints.dimensions: 360 mm deep receiving beam · 40 mm housing · 180 mm deep dovetail

joints.name: Wedged crossing ties
joints.description: Two penetrating ties meet a post at separate levels. Opposing hardwood wedges close the gaps above the ties in four assembly stages.
joints.sequence: Insert the lower tie · insert the upper tie · seat the lower wedges · seat the upper wedges.
joints.dimensions: 400 mm post · two 140 × 200 mm ties · 60 mm opposing wedge pairs

joints.name: Gooseneck lap splice
joints.description: A narrow neck leads to a broad hooked head. The matching socket resists lengthwise separation while a lower seat supports the lap.
joints.sequence: Lower the gooseneck into its matching socket and seat the lap.
joints.dimensions: 320 mm square section · 380 mm head and neck · half-depth seat

joints.name: The four-faced interlock
joints.description: Goosenecks appear on all four faces. Their hidden cutting direction runs across the diagonal of the post, allowing the two undercut halves to slide past one another.
joints.sequence: Follow the diagonal, then orbit the seated joint to read the four faces.
joints.dimensions: 480 mm square post · 1,300 mm tall · 420 mm interlocking zone

stages.label: Slide along the concealed diagonal
stages.note: The hooks share one diagonal cutting direction. A straight pull along either side is blocked.

joints.name: Concealed shell-mouth
joints.description: Four long triangular cheeks exchange places around the post. At both ends, slender V-shaped integral tongues disappear into blind pockets in the opposite shoulder.
joints.sequence: Open the post to find the four hidden tongues. Lower it again and watch the seams close.
joints.dimensions: 480 mm square · 600 mm cheeks · four V-shaped 45 mm blind tongues · 4 mm central relief

stages.label: Interleave the triangular cheeks
stages.note: Opposing cheeks pass beside each other. Stop at the next step to inspect the V-shaped tips.

stages.label: Seat the four concealed tongues
stages.note: The final 45 mm seats four V-shaped tongues in blind shoulder sockets.

joints.name: One cut, three directions
joints.description: Three interlocking fingers share a cubic centre. Reorient the moving member to form a straight splice or two different corners. A modern geometric study after Kawai’s invention.
joints.sequence: Separate before choosing an orientation. Each configuration closes along the same body diagonal.
joints.dimensions: 480 mm cube · three cyclic orientations · equal nominal sectors · symmetric 0.4° seams · 4 mm axial relief

stages.label: Close along the cube’s body diagonal
stages.note: All three fingers advance on the body diagonal. The small seam clearance is intentional; change orientation only when separated.
stages.reverseLabel: Open along the cube’s body diagonal

joints.name: The locked mitred corner
joints.description: Three clean mitres conceal crossed rail tongues and two long tenons. The rails engage first; the upright then enters both, closing and locking the corner.
joints.sequence: Engage the two rail tongues, then lower the twin-tenoned upright.
joints.dimensions: 480 mm square stock · 1,280 mm arms · 60 mm twin tenons · illustrative proportions

stages.label: Engage the crossed rail tongues
stages.note: Two staggered rail tongues engage first. The upright remains clear above them.

stages.label: Lower the twin-tenoned upright
stages.note: The upright enters both rails; its twin tenons prevent the sliding rail from withdrawing.

joints.detail: Two staggered rail tongues lie behind the mitred faces. The upright’s integral tenons enter pockets in the joined rails. This is a dimensional reconstruction of the mechanism, not a measured tracing of the specimen.
